messages.body: Hi, Dr. Nakamura referred me for 8 PT visits with Priya Bhatt. Can I keep the Wednesday 4:00 pm slot for all of them? I get off work at 3:30.
Hello Rosa, yes. We have you on Wednesdays at 4:00 pm from September 9 through October 28. Please give us 24 hours notice if you need to change a visit.
I came down with a fever tonight and will not make it to tomorrow's 4:00 pm visit (October 21). Please cancel it; I will keep the October 28 visit.

Thanks Rosa, the October 21 visit is cancelled. Feel better. Because the cancellation came in after 4:00 pm the day before, the system applied the late cancellation fee; billing can review that if you write to them.
Understood, I will write to billing. Thank you.

threads.subject: Denied physical therapy claims and October statement

messages.body: My October 7 PT visit (claim clm-0815) shows as denied with "no referral on file". Dr. Nakamura referred me on September 2 and the first four visits were paid. Can you check what happened?

Hi Rosa, we see the denial. The referral in our system shows an effective date of September 9, 2026, and the insurer treats visits after October 1 as needing a renewed referral. We have asked Dr. Nakamura's office to send a backdated referral. You do not need to do anything yet.

My October statement arrived and shows $460 due with a past-due note and a line about collections. $370 of that is the two denied visits you said you were fixing, and $50 is a cancellation fee for a visit I cancelled through the scheduling thread. Please advise.
The referring office has sent the backdated referral and corrected claims for visits five and six were resubmitted today. Please allow 30 days. The collections line on your statement is automated.
Since finishing PT my shoulder is much better, but it aches after the gym. Is it OK to take ibuprofen 400 mg before workouts, and should I keep doing the band exercises every day?

Hi Rosa, ibuprofen 400 mg with food up to three times a day is fine for a few days at a time unless Dr. Okafor has told you otherwise. Keep the band exercises to the three days a week Priya recommended rather than daily, and rest if the ache lasts more than two hours after a workout.

One more thing: Priya's home program sheet says to switch to the heavier band only once you can do 15 pain-free repetitions. We booked your follow-up with Dr. Okafor for November 24 at 10:30 am; she will review the labs then.
Hello Rosa, Dr. Castellanos has a schedule change on June 11. We moved your mole check to Thursday, June 18 at 8:00 am. Reply here if that does not work.
June 18 at 8:00 works, thanks.
My June 18 dermatology visit shows $50 due. My plan says specialist visits are $50 but my primary care copay is $30; I just want to confirm $50 is right before I pay.
Hi Rosa, that is correct: Cascade PPO Silver applies a $50 specialist copay for dermatology. You can pay in the portal under Billing.
Paid, thank you.
My palpitations come back in the evening after coffee. Should I stop coffee before the March 11 visit with Dr. Singh?
Hi Rosa, keep your usual routine so the ECG reflects a normal day, but note the time of each episode. Call 911 for chest pain, fainting or shortness of breath.
Will do, thank you.

threads.subject: Lab results from the August physical

messages.body: My lab results are posted but I do not understand the LDL line. Is 128 something to worry about?
Hello Rosa, Dr. Okafor reviewed the results: LDL 128 is slightly above the goal of 100. She recommends diet changes and a repeat lipid panel in six months; no medication for now.
I have four lisinopril tablets left and my February 10 visit is next week. Can the refill wait until then?
Hi Rosa, Dr. Okafor sent a seven-day bridge refill to your pharmacy so you do not run out before the visit.
